content:
anya: Heads up — nightly eval flagged a quality regression for rwd-v2-small after the KV prefetch kernel change landed. Failures concentrated on summarization_longform and persona_consistency prompt sets. sample outputs attached

matt: Oof. Any obvious diffs in tokenization or sequence length?

kiran: I landed the prefetch patch yesterday (commit f3a9b1c). It pulls next-kv pages earlier to reduce stall latency. No intentional RNG or sampling changes.

olga: Nightly metrics: summarization_longform pass rate dropped from 92.4% -> 86.1% (2026-03-19 -> 2026-03-20 job). perplexity distribution shifted slightly higher for longer sequences.

anya: Example reproducer (short):
```
# nightly-eval reproduce
python tools/eval_promptset.py --model rwd-v2-small --promptset summarization_longform --seed 42 --max-tokens 256 --server localhost:8080
```

anya: Short sample before/after (truncated):
```
-- baseline (pre-change):
Input: Long article about climate policy...
Output: "In summary, the policy prioritizes X and Y, which will likely lead to Z by 2030."

-- after prefetch (post-change):
Input: Long article about climate policy...
Output: "Policy is complex. Many factors influence outcomes."
```

jess: Those look like sampling collapse / early termination issues. Could be KV cache race causing decoder to see a shorter effective context window. Did the commit touch cache lifetime or invalidation?

kiran: It touches prefetch ordering and anatomic page reads: we now prefetch into a temp buffer and then swap. There is a narrow window where concurrent reads + sampling thread could reference an empty page if swap isn't gated properly. I added a lightweight flag but maybe it's insufficient.

matt: Can we reproduce locally with stress (concurrent clients) and a deterministic seed? If it's a race you'll need high concurrency to trigger.

olga: I reran the nightly with --concurrency 8 and saw the failure rate climb to 18% on the failing promptsets. With concurrency 1 it matches baseline.

ci-bot: nightly-job/18012346 finished with status: unstable. Logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/nightly/18012346

jess: For debugging: add a mode to disable prefetch swap (fall back to old path) and compare generation logits for the same seed. Also capture KV page occupancy at each decode step.

kiran: I'll push a diagnostic build tonight with swap gated by an env var PRELOAD_SWAP_GUARDED=1 and extra metrics: kvcache.page_hits, kvcache.page_reads, prefetch.swap_count. Patch PR: https://git.internal/rw/rt/merge_requests/3921

anya: Can we canary rollback prefetch on hosted canaries until fix? This is affecting customer-facing latency/quality tradeoffs.

matt: Yes — revert on canary lanes and mark as rollback until we have a non-racy fix. Also add an e2e nightly test with concurrency=8 for long-context promptsets.

kiran: Agreed. I'll open a revert PR for canaries and land diagnostic PR. Planning to also add a unit test that simulates concurrent prefetch+read.

olga: Action items: 1) revert canary (matt) 2) diagnostic build + metrics (kiran) 3) add e2e concurrency test to nightly (jess/olga) 4) triage logs and attach failing seeds to bug (anya).

matt: Ping me once diagnostic metrics are up. If we confirm race I'll add a hotfix to gate swap with a mutex + micro-bench to quantify impact.

kiran: Will do. Thanks for quick triage. I'll also dump failing seeds into the bug tracker so QA can reproduce deterministically.

anya: I'll attach a few failing seeds and canonical IO to the issue. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
